DocumentParseOnlineApi.description_en: Extracts text from images in natural reading order and outputs formatted results with support for bounding boxes and content. Output formats include JSON and Markdown
DocumentParseOnlineApi.description_zh: 智能文档解析产品，支持提取图片中的文字并按照自然阅读顺序进行格式化输出，同时支持boundingbox和内容的输出，输出格式支持json和markdown
